cases.case_label: AluYa5 at BRCA2 c.156_157 (hereditary cancer, GS validation case 33)
cases.mechanism_detail: A previously identified pathogenic Alu (Ya5-like) insertion at BRCA2 c.156_157 with 14-bp TSD and polyA tail was re-detected by genome sequencing as part of a validation cohort; this paper does not describe its molecular consequence.
cases.quote: Manual review of the alignment file confirmed the presence of a poly-A tail and a 14-bp target site duplication sequence (Figure 4A), similar to previously described.
